dateCheck.title: DATE CHECK
dateCheck.intro: Left out on purpose. These are Thursday 19 or Friday 20 November, not Saturday's news:
items: Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, South Africa's first female deputy president, dies (20 Nov)
S&P 500 and Dow in correction (Fri 20 Nov)
Kryvyi Rih ballistic strike: 2 killed, including a 7-year-old, about 60 hurt (Fri)
Equinor says the cyberattack has stopped (20 Nov)
A second judge blocks Trump's DC memorial arch; Connecticut ICE-mask ruling; Iraq Jurf al-Nasr deal (Fri 20 Nov)
European student and youth protests, including Berlin "GenZ regelt" (Fri 20 Nov)
Japan closes EV subsidy applications early (Fri night)
EU Council authorises signing of the Indonesia FTA (18 Nov)
Friday Russian objects in Polish airspace; Friday Jazan intercepts and Hodeidah strikes
Kyiv Dnipro bridges and Friday's wider barrage
COP31 Friday close, separate from Saturday overtime
Anthropic IPO first trade and Friday's Asia close
Trump "tremendous tax" remarks on overseas data centres (Fri)

stories.headline: COP31 runs into Saturday overtime
stories.deck: No cover decision adopted. Third draft due Saturday. Kurum: "We are close to the finish line, but we are not there yet."

stories.headline: 3 missiles downed over Riyadh*
stories.deck: Coalition says three Houthi missiles were shot down over Riyadh, then a drone in the south. Alert 01:53 local.

stories.headline: Peru M6.7, no deaths reported
stories.deck: 00:09 UTC, 30 km NW of Junín, depth 129 km. Junín, Pasco, Huánuco and Lima damaged. One woman hurt in central Lima. No tsunami alert.

stories.headline: Rutte: allies stand with Poland
stories.deck: "All allies stand in full solidarity with Poland." Called dangerous and unacceptable. More air defence sought; no Article 4.

stories.headline: 148 drones and 3 missiles
stories.deck: 117 drones downed overnight; hits at 19 places.

stories.line: Podil: missile hit, two houses burned, one person hurt.

stories.headline: Killer-robot talks fail
stories.deck: No binding mandate. US and Russia resisted. Rules by 2028.

stories.headline: Costa's €1.78tn EU budget
stories.deck: 10% under the plan. Cohesion cut; 3% levy. Élysée: "very disappointing".

stories.line: France Act VI marches; about 70,000 police. Turnout falling.
Gaza: Palestinian media say 3 killed in a city strike.
IRGC claims it downed a US MQ-9 over Hormuz ("58th").
Hormuz: 6 AIS-visible crossings, about 9% of normal.

stories.headline: PX19: all 146 safe
stories.deck: PNG COP31 team aboard. Davao slide; all 146 unhurt.

stories.headline: India 486-4, lead 118
stories.deck: KL Rahul 136, a 13th Test ton. Gill out for 98. Day 3 stumps.

stories.line: Cricket Australia unanimously backs Pat Cummins as captain.
Urabandai: over 1,000 cut off by snow and fallen trees.
BTS win five MAMA awards in Osaka; Cortis take song of the year.
Sejong: five freight cars derail; Saemaeul and Mugunghwa stop.
Lee at an Ulsan AI site; repeats the won 100m CSAT reward.
Seoul: a bus hits the pavement at Hongik; six hurt.
Kyushu basho: Onosato and Wakamotoharu tied at 12-2.
Princess Aiko returns home from her Singapore visit.
Choi Min-jeong wins a third straight 1,000m title, in Seoul.
South Korea: university essay and interview exams begin.

stories.headline: Toxic liquor kills 11
stories.deck: 180+ hospitalised in Chandel; probe ordered. Deccan says 300.

stories.headline: Garment unrest shuts mills
stories.deck: 50–80 factories on holiday. Clashes in Ashulia.

stories.line: PCB contracts for 38 omit Rizwan, Shan Masood and Saim Ayub.
SCO forum in India: Pakistan calls climate the "enemy".
Kenya: a party seeks orders against the IEBC CEO pick.
Nigeria: Peter Obi vows to end kidnappings and corruption.
Premium Times: nearly 600 women killed in three months.
Eswatini: foam on the Ngwempisi prompts a pollution probe.
African Group: "we came to claim what is rightfully ours"; $120bn.

stories.headline: Verstappen on pole
stories.deck: Antonelli 1:33.893, 5-place penalty. Russell 2, Norris 3. Race not run.

stories.line: St. Johns near Cocoa at 18.76 ft; Rockledge told to be ready.
Spaniards abroad begin voting for the 29 Nov election.
Bitcoin about $58,460, down about 5% in 24 hours (12:30 UTC).
Astronomers find a nearby "weirdo" triple-star system.
Australia: dozens of rallies on midwife homebirth rules.
Gold Coast Schoolies week begins, with numbers down.
Tocumwal: four people struck by lightning at a festival.
Sydney: two teens stabbed; a 17-year-old is charged.
Japan's ministry weighs ISP blocking after the GMO breach.
Kunio Tashima stays in the FIFA presidential race.
Tochigi: express train hits a car; all 300 unhurt.*

stories.headline: BepiColombo at Mercury
stories.deck: 37-min burn from 18:24 UTC. MPO and Mio joined until 9–10 Dec.

stories.line: Alcaraz beats Shelton 3-6 6-3 7-6(1); into Sunday's final.
City 1-1 Fulham (Haaland goal ruled out); Newcastle 2-2 Arsenal; Chelsea 1-4 Leeds.

stories.headline: England 37-12 All Blacks
stories.deck: Record Nations Championship win over New Zealand.
